responsibility: This file implements GCC’s generic RTL reader used by both the compiler and generator programs. It parses the textual RTL syntax into rtx objects, supports mode/code/int/subst iterators and attributes from machine description files, handles vectors, strings, registers, repeated elements, compact dump syntax, and target-specific token resolution, and provides the reusable rtx_reader base that specialized readers such as the full function loader build on. It is the core parser for textual RTL and MD constructs.
